about_the_game:
Skipper, Dipper, and Mable are back! Having successfully crossed the Crystalline Sea in their last Great Adventure, they are ready for new challenges, harder puzzles and new obstacles - are you ready? Welcome to Skipper2: Hijinks!

Skipper2 is a fun, challenging, relaxing puzzle game with 25+ levels to bend your mind and challenge your problem solving ability.

Skipper2's controls are simple and the game's difficulty has an approachable learning curve making puzzlers of all abilities able to easily dive into the game.

Regular (free!) puzzle packs will drop for the game at least quarterly.

Skipper2 brings you

  • Unique challenges across 25+ puzzles

  • SteamDeck Support

  • Most puzzles can be solved in more than one way

  • Regular drops of new puzzles for free

  • Keyboard and Gamepad controls

  • An environment as unique as it is relaxing

  • A soothing sound track and effects

  • Lots of Steam Achievements

Skipper2 Has between 1.5 and 4 hours of gameplay
